# hiok_container (Data Source)

Look up an existing container by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hiok_container" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `dns_hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `image` (String)
- `status` (String)
